digest.overview: 本期焦點在終端客戶的資本支出與先進封裝動向:台積電法說重申今年資本支出600-640億美元不變,並預估未來三年投資高於過去,還傳出評估德州建廠及與馬斯克合作,對PVD機台與靶材的中長期需求是正面支撐。不過SK海力士傳出HBM4設備訂單延期,記憶體端擴產節奏出現雜音。美國方面,格芯在台積電合作下成為全美首座可量產矽中介層的晶圓廠,美政府將取得格芯4%股權,紐約新廠也將獲日本210億美元資金,在地化先進封裝供應鏈逐步成形。靶材廠方面,有研新材前三季歸母淨利2.63億元,年增7.3%;JX金屬雖創最高獲利,卻因公開收購(TOB)與可轉債(CB)消息股價急落;江豐電子則推動H股上市並提議回購股份。其餘多為股價、盤勢資訊,參考價值有限。
key_trends: 晶圓龍頭資本支出維持高檔:台積電重申600-640億美元年度資本支出,並估未來三年投資高於過去,先進製程與先進封裝的PVD機台及銅、鉭、鈦、鈷等靶材需求可望延續成長。
先進封裝成為新增需求主軸:格芯取得矽中介層量產能力,法人點名日月光、力成受惠先進封裝商機;中介層、RDL、凸塊製程帶動的PVD與靶材需求持續擴大。
美國半導體在地化加速:美政府入股格芯、日本資金挹注紐約新廠,加上台積電評估德州建廠,北美靶材的在地供應、認證與物流布局重要性提升。
記憶體擴產節奏出現不確定性:SK海力士HBM4設備訂單傳延期,可能讓相關PVD設備與靶材拉貨時程後移,與晶圓代工端的強勁需求形成分化。
靶材大廠進入資本運作期:JX金屬推出TOB與CB,江豐電子籌備H股上市並提議回購,有研新材獲利穩健成長;業者正透過資本市場籌資,強化擴產與競爭力。
watch_points: SK海力士HBM4設備訂單延期的規模與期間,以及是否波及三星、美光等記憶體廠的PVD機台與靶材採購。
台積電德州建廠評估及與馬斯克的合作內容,是否帶動北美新產能及在地靶材供應需求。
JX金屬TOB與CB的資金用途,特別是半導體靶材擴產計畫,對價格與供應格局的影響。
江豐電子H股上市進度與募資投向,以及中國靶材廠(江豐、有研新材)的海外擴張與價格競爭。
格芯矽中介層量產與日月光、力成先進封裝擴產進度,追蹤封裝端PVD設備訂單與靶材認證機會。

papers.title: LANTHANUM NICKEL ALLOY SPUTTERING TARGET (LANI)
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The Lanthanum Nickel Alloy Sputtering Target (LaNi) is a crucial component in thin-film deposition processes. Consisting of lanthanum and nickel, this alloy possesses specialized properties suitable for coating applications. LaNi targets play an essential role across diverse industries, facilitating the creation of advanced coatings with improved functionalities and performance attributes. Purity: 99.99% Application of Lanthanum Nickel Alloy Sputtering Target (LaNi) 01 Electrochromic Coatings: LaNi alloy coatings can be utilized in the development of electrochromic devices, which change their optical properties in response to an applied electrical voltage. These smart coatings can be applied to windows, mirrors, and displays, allowing for dynamic control over light transmission, reflectivity, and color. This technology offers significant benefits in terms of energy efficiency and user comfort in automotive and architectural applications. 02 Anti-Reflective Coatings: By optimizing the composition and structure of LaNi alloy thin films, it is possible to create anti-reflective coatings that significantly reduce light reflection from the surface of optical components. This application is particularly valuable in improving the efficiency of solar panels, enhancing the visibility of display screens, and increasing the light transmission of optical lenses. 03 Protective Coatings: LaNi alloy coatings can provide excellent protection for sensitive optical components. These coatings can shield surfaces from environmental degradation, including corrosion, oxidation, and wear, thereby extending the lifespan of optical devices used in harsh or demanding conditions. 04 Magnetic Optical Materials: The incorporation of nickel lends magnetic properties to the LaNi alloy, making it suitable for use in magneto-optical applications. These materials can be used to create optical isolators, which prevent back reflections in laser systems, and magneto-optical modulators, which are essential components in advanced communication systems. 05 Conductive Transparent Films: Although more challenging, it may be possible to engineer LaNi alloy coatings to exhibit both high optical transparency and electrical conductivity. Such films could find applications as transparent electrodes in optoelectronic devices, including light-emitting diodes (LEDs), photodetectors, and thin-film solar cells. papers.title_zh: 鑭鎳合金濺鍍靶材(LaNi)
papers.abstract_zh: 鑭鎳合金濺鍍靶材(LaNi)是薄膜沉積製程中的關鍵元件。此合金由鑭與鎳組成,具備適用於鍍膜應用的特殊性質。LaNi 靶材在多元產業中扮演重要角色,有助於製作具備更佳功能與性能的先進鍍膜。純度:99.99% 鑭鎳合金濺鍍靶材(LaNi)的應用 01 電致變色鍍膜:LaNi 合金鍍膜可用於開發電致變色元件,此類元件會隨施加電壓改變其光學性質。這類智慧鍍膜可應用於窗戶、鏡子與顯示器,動態控制光穿透率、反射率與顏色。此技術在汽車與建築應用中,可大幅提升能源效率與使用舒適度。02 抗反射鍍膜:透過最佳化 LaNi 合金薄膜的成分與結構,可製作出抗反射鍍膜,大幅降低光學元件表面的光反射。此應用對提升太陽能板效率、增進顯示螢幕可視性,以及提高光學鏡片透光率特別有價值。03 保護鍍膜:LaNi 合金鍍膜可為敏感的光學元件提供優異保護,使表面免受腐蝕、氧化與磨耗等環境劣化影響,進而延長在嚴苛條件下使用之光學元件的壽命。04 磁光材料:鎳的加入使 LaNi 合金具有磁性,適用於磁光應用。這類材料可用於製作光隔離器(防止雷射系統中的背向反射),以及先進通訊系統中不可或缺的磁光調變器。05 透明導電膜:雖然難度較高,但仍有可能設計出兼具高光學透明度與導電性的 LaNi 合金鍍膜。此類薄膜可作為光電元件中的透明電極,包括發光二極體(LED)、光偵測器與薄膜太陽能電池。身為鍍膜材料供應商,我們可提供各類相關產品。如有興趣,歡迎留言與我們聯繫。

papers.title: Hot oscillating pressure sintering W-Ti refractory alloy targets for integrated circuit chips under different sintering pressures
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part L Journal of Materials Design and Applications
papers.abstract: The density, grain size, and microstructural uniformity of tungsten-titanium (W-Ti) refractory alloy targets directly affect the quality of sputtered coatings. In this work, 90W-10Ti (mass fraction) alloy targets for integrated circuit chips were prepared by hot oscillatory pressing (HOP) sintering at pressures of 40, 50, and 60 MPa. The effects of sintering pressure on the microstructural evolution, densification behavior, and properties of the HOP-sintered alloy were investigated. The results showed that increasing the sintering pressure markedly improved the microstructural homogeneity of the alloy. Higher sintering pressure also significantly increased the relative density by accelerating densification, yielding a maximum relative density of 97.13%. Moreover, at a sintering pressure of 60 MPa, grain growth was effectively suppressed, and the average grain size reached 1.82 μm. The dominant densification mechanism shifted from lattice and grain-boundary diffusion at low pressure to plastic deformation at high pressure, as indicated by a stress exponent, n, greater than 3, thereby yielding a maximum Vickers hardness of 496.39 HV30 and a minimum corrosion current density (Icorr) of 8.63 × 10 −6 A/cm 2 . Increasing the HOP sintering pressure therefore enabled the effective preparation of W-Ti refractory alloy targets with high density, fine grains, high hardness, and excellent corrosion resistance.

papers.title: Phase transformation mechanism of Ti/Ti 5 Si 3 dual-phase targets via ball milling modification and SPS
papers.abstract: Commercial TiSi targets typically consist of coexisting Ti, TiSi 2 , and Ti 5 Si 3 phases, inducing severe differential etching and elemental segregation during sputtering. This causes compositional inhomogeneity and poor service stability of deposited TiSiN coatings, limiting their large-scale application under extreme operating conditions. To address this industrial bottleneck, this work employs TiH 2 powder to replace conventional high-purity Ti powder. By coupling ball milling modification with the intrinsic dehydrogenation of TiH 2 , homogeneous Ti-Si targets with a dual-phase Ti/Ti 5 Si 3 structure are fabricated via spark plasma sintering (SPS). The effects of ball milling on the microstructure and dehydrogenation behavior of TiH 2 -TiSi 2 mixed powders, as well as subsequent sintering densification and phase evolution, are systematically investigated, and the coupling mechanism among dehydrogenation, densification, and phase transformation is elucidated. The optimised ball milling process refines the volume-based median particle size Dv(50) to 0.306 μm and achieves complete TiSi 2 -to-Ti 5 Si 3 phase transformation at 700°C. The as-prepared target reaches a relative density of 99.87%, with uniformly dispersed Ti and Si elements whose atomic ratio matches the designed Ti:Si = 75:25, and a Vickers hardness exceeding 1000 HV. This work provides a reliable technical route and theoretical support for the low-cost fabrication of highly homogeneous Ti-Si targets, with important engineering implications for improving the service stability of TiSiN coatings.

papers.title: Process for Preparing Molybdenum-Silicon Alloy Targets
papers.abstract: With the development of emerging fields such as big data, artificial intelligence, and 5G communication, the critical dimensions of integrated circuits are constantly shrinking. As a high-precision tool used for pattern transfer in the lithography process, the quality of photomasks directly determines the final performance of circuits. Molybdenum silicide alloys with high silicon content have become key materials for the light-absorbing film layer in advanced photomasks due to their excellent properties such as optical tunability, ease of etching, chemical resistance, and radiation resistance. The quality of the film is highly dependent on the magnetron sputtering target material, and the development of high-uniformity and high-density molybdenum silicide alloy targets is of crucial importance. Traditional powder metallurgy methods for producing Mo-Si targets often yield compositional inhomogeneities, coarse grain structures, and cracking due to density differences between Mo and Si phases and the exothermic reaction between molybdenum and silicon. This poses significant challenges in target fabrication. This study proposes a systemic “powder pre-alloying + hot-press sintering” process. Using a mixed powder with a molybdenum-silicon atomic ratio of 1:9 as raw material, systematically investigating the effect of heat treatment temperature on molybdenum-silicon alloying. The optimal temperature was determined to be 1350 °C with a 2-h soak. The phase evolution sequence during the molybdenum-silicon reaction was elucidated as Mo + Si → Mo3Si + Si → Mo5Si3 + Si → MoSi2. Further investigations revealed that the resulting Si-MoSi2 alloy powder exhibits brittle-brittle system characteristics. Mechanical ball milling continuously refines the particles, increasing the surface energy and density of microdefects in the powder, which helps improve the powder’s sintering activity, enabling the successful production of molybdenum-silicon targets with a relative density no less than 99% and markedly improved microstructural uniformity.

papers.title_zh: 鉬矽合金靶材之製備製程
papers.abstract_zh: 隨著大數據、人工智慧與 5G 通訊等新興領域發展,積體電路的關鍵尺寸持續微縮。光罩作為微影製程中圖形轉移的高精度工具,其品質直接決定電路的最終性能。高矽含量的矽化鉬合金因具備光學可調性、易蝕刻、耐化學性及耐輻射等優異特性,已成為先進光罩吸光膜層的關鍵材料。薄膜品質高度仰賴磁控濺鍍靶材,因此開發高均勻性、高密度的矽化鉬合金靶材至關重要。傳統粉末冶金法製作 Mo-Si 靶材時,因 Mo 與 Si 相的密度差異以及鉬矽之間的放熱反應,常導致成分不均、晶粒粗大及開裂,為靶材製作帶來重大挑戰。本研究提出系統性的「粉末預合金化 + 熱壓燒結」製程,以鉬矽原子比 1:9 的混合粉末為原料,系統性探討熱處理溫度對鉬矽合金化的影響,確定最佳溫度為 1350 °C、持溫 2 小時,並闡明鉬矽反應過程中的相演變順序為 Mo + Si → Mo3Si + Si → Mo5Si3 + Si → MoSi2。進一步研究發現,所得 Si-MoSi2 合金粉末呈現脆-脆系統特性。機械球磨可持續細化顆粒,提高粉末表面能與微缺陷密度,有助於提升粉末燒結活性,成功製備出相對密度不低於 99% 且顯微組織均勻性顯著改善的鉬矽靶材。

papers.title: MoO 3 /MgF 2 Distributed Bragg Reflectors for Colloidal Quantum Dot-Based Planar Microcavities
papers.abstract: Planar optical microcavities based on distributed Bragg reflectors (DBRs) are key components of integrated photonics.Because the active layer is sandwiched between the top and bottom DBRs, the fabrication of a low-damage top mirror is particularly important to minimize plasmaor thermally induced degradation of the active material.Here, we demonstrate a thermally evaporated MoO 3 /MgF 2 DBR as a low-damage top mirror for planar microcavities.Spectroscopic ellipsometry was used to determine the dispersive optical constants of MgF 2 and MoO 3 , modeled using Cauchy and Tauc-Lorentz models, respectively.These parameters enabled transfer-matrix-based DBR design with a stopband centered at 560 nm.By employing a low deposition rate of ~0.2 Å/s to reduce film stress, MoO 3 /MgF 2 multilayers with thicknesses close to quarter-wave targets were fabricated, achieving approximately 90 % reflectance and a stopband width of about 260 nm for a 4-pair DBR.Integration with a sputtered SiO 2 /Ti 3 O 5 bottom DBR and a spin-coated InP/ZnS colloidal quantum dot active layer produced a planar microcavity that narrowed the emission linewidth from 35 to 3 nm and exhibited parabolic angle-resolved photon dispersions with effective indices near 2.0.These results demonstrate the feasibility of MoO 3 /MgF 2 DBRs as promising low-damage top mirrors for solution-processed microcavity devices.

papers.abstract_zh: 以分散式布拉格反射鏡(DBR)為基礎的平面光學微共振腔是整合光子學的關鍵元件。由於主動層夾於上下 DBR 之間,製作低損傷的上反射鏡格外重要,以將電漿或熱所引起的主動材料劣化降至最低。本研究展示以熱蒸鍍製備的 MoO 3 /MgF 2 DBR 作為平面微共振腔的低損傷上反射鏡。利用橢圓偏光光譜術測定 MgF 2 與 MoO 3 的色散光學常數,分別以 Cauchy 與 Tauc-Lorentz 模型建模。這些參數使得能以轉移矩陣法設計中心位於 560 nm 的阻帶 DBR。採用約 0.2 Å/s 的低沉積速率以降低薄膜應力,製作出厚度接近四分之一波長目標的 MoO 3 /MgF 2 多層膜,4 對 DBR 達到約 90 % 反射率與約 260 nm 的阻帶寬度。結合濺鍍 SiO 2 /Ti 3 O 5 下 DBR 與旋塗 InP/ZnS 膠體量子點主動層,所製成的平面微共振腔使發光線寬由 35 nm 窄化至 3 nm,並呈現有效折射率接近 2.0 的拋物線型角解析光子色散。這些結果證明 MoO 3 /MgF 2 DBR 作為溶液製程微共振腔元件之低損傷上反射鏡的可行性與潛力。

papers.title: Sputtering Mechanism of an Unsintered Organic–Inorganic Sputtering Target for Perovskite Solar Cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Vacuum‐based deposition of hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites (HOIPs) remains a critical yet unresolved challenge for enabling scalable, solvent‐free manufacturing of perovskite optoelectronics. Here, tetragonal methylammonium lead iodide ( β ‐MAPbI 3 ) single‐phase crystals with high structural uniformity are synthesized via an antisolvent vapor‐assisted crystallization process and utilized as feedstock for a 3‐inch unsintered MAPbI 3 sputtering target fabricated through mechanochemical processing and low‐temperature consolidation. The resulting target exhibits sufficient compactness and mechanical integrity to sustain RF magnetron sputtering without macroscopic fracture while retaining its β ‐phase crystallographic signature under plasma exposure. However, sputtered films derived from this target consistently exhibit PbI 2 ‐dominant characteristics. Correlative analysis of target surface evolution and film composition indicates a progressive loss of organic and iodine species during sputtering, leading to a compositionally altered sputtered flux. Such behavior can be reasonably attributed to the combined effects of energetic ion bombardment and photon irradiation intrinsic to RF plasma environments. Consequently, direct sputter deposition does not readily preserve MAPbI 3 stoichiometry, even when high‐quality single‐phase crystal‐derived targets are employed, suggesting that post‐deposition reconstruction strategies may be required to restore the perovskite phase. This work provides fundamental insights into plasma–perovskite interactions and establishes a foundation for sputtering‐based routes toward scalable perovskite photoabsorber fabrication.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 以真空製程沉積有機-無機混成鈣鈦礦(HOIPs),是實現可規模化、無溶劑鈣鈦礦光電元件製造的關鍵,但至今仍是未解決的挑戰。本研究以反溶劑蒸氣輔助結晶製程合成具高結構均勻性的四方晶相甲基銨碘化鉛(β-MAPbI3)單相晶體,並將其作為原料,經機械化學處理與低溫固結製成 3 吋未燒結 MAPbI3 濺鍍靶材。所得靶材具備足夠的緻密度與機械完整性,可承受 RF 磁控濺鍍而不產生巨觀破裂,且在電漿曝露下仍保有 β 相的晶體學特徵。然而,由此靶材濺鍍所得的薄膜始終呈現以 PbI2 為主的特性。靶材表面演變與薄膜組成的關聯分析顯示,濺鍍過程中有機物種與碘物種逐漸流失,導致濺鍍通量的組成改變。此現象可合理歸因於 RF 電漿環境中固有的高能離子轟擊與光子照射的綜合效應。因此,即使採用高品質單相晶體製成的靶材,直接濺鍍沉積仍不易維持 MAPbI3 的化學計量比,顯示可能需要沉積後重建策略來恢復鈣鈦礦相。本研究提供了電漿與鈣鈦礦交互作用的基礎見解,並為以濺鍍途徑實現可規模化鈣鈦礦光吸收層製造奠定基礎。

papers.title: The effect of thermal mechanical process on high purity 0.65 inch tantalum targets for advanced process chip
papers.abstract: Abstract Tantalum (Ta)/Tantalum-Nitride (TaN) layers are extensively used as sputtering sources of copper–silicon (Cu–Si) diffusion barriers. The advanced process chips inclined toward requires high purity, and more economically efficient long lifetime 0.65 inch Ta sputtering target. In the present work, the effect of thermal mechanical process including forging and annealing on 0.65 inch Ta target was analyzed. The microstructure results indicated that 4 times forging and annealing at 1223 K, 1 h process could reduce Ta grain size to the smallest of 48.7 µ m with grains fully recrystallized. Based on 4 times forging process, the annealing process after rolling was researched in detail. The effect of increasing annealing temperature on deformation microstructure is mainly reflected in grain size evolution and distribution of crystallographic orientations. The Ta blank after rolling and annealing at 1373 K, 15 mins, the average grain size shows 63.5 µ m with grain orientations uniform distribution on the cross section of Ta blank, the grain orientation proportion of <100>, <110> and <111> is 15.8%, 3.8%, 32.3%, respectively, which could meet the requirements of advanced process chips for 0.65 inch Ta targets.

papers.title: Current Application Status and Development Direction of High-end Magnetron Sputtering Target in China
papers.venue: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)
papers.abstract: High-end magnetron sputtering targets serve as the core foundational materials for fabricating critical functional films used in integrated circuits and flat panel displays. China currently faces a high external dependency in this field, along with persistent structural challenges such as weak fundamental research, lagging high-purity material preparation technologies, and reliance on imported core equipment. This study reviews the application status of high-end magnetron sputtering targets in two major fields—semiconductor chips and flat panel displays, and identifies common issues including micro-composition and structural homogeneity of raw materials and targets, preparation and testing equipment for sputtering targets, and the transition to smart manufacturing. It proposes key development directions for the sputtering target industry, such as research on micro-homogenization of composition and structure of ultra-high purity targets, collaborative efforts across the industrial chain to tackle key equipment for target processing and testing, driving research paradigm transformation through digital‒intelligent integration, and focusing on forward-looking layouts of critical fields. Practical actions can be taken in areas including developing high-purity material purification and processing technologies, deepening industry‒university‒research‒application collaborative innovation mechanisms, improving the industrial chain and standards systems, balancing independent talent cultivation with targeted recruitment, and reshaping the innovation ecosystem of the sputtering target industry. These measures will help transition China's sputtering target industry from a follower model featuring "equipment introduction‒process imitation" to an innovative "data-driven‒standard-led" paradigm, thereby supporting the development needs of strategic emerging industries such as integrated circuits and flat panel displays.

papers.abstract_zh: 高階磁控濺鍍靶材是製作積體電路與平面顯示器關鍵功能薄膜的核心基礎材料。中國目前在此領域對外依存度高,且長期面臨基礎研究薄弱、高純材料製備技術落後、核心設備仰賴進口等結構性挑戰。本研究回顧高階磁控濺鍍靶材在半導體晶片與平面顯示器兩大領域的應用現況,並歸納出共通問題,包括原料與靶材的微觀成分與結構均勻性、濺鍍靶材製備與檢測設備,以及向智慧製造轉型等。研究提出濺鍍靶材產業的重點發展方向,例如超高純靶材成分與結構微觀均勻化研究、產業鏈協同攻關靶材加工與檢測關鍵設備、以數智融合驅動研究範式轉變,以及聚焦關鍵領域的前瞻佈局。可採取的實際行動包括:發展高純材料純化與加工技術、深化產學研用協同創新機制、完善產業鏈與標準體系、兼顧自主人才培育與精準引才,以及重塑濺鍍靶材產業創新生態。這些措施將有助於推動中國濺鍍靶材產業由「設備引進—製程模仿」的跟隨模式,轉向「數據驅動—標準引領」的創新範式,進而支撐積體電路與平面顯示器等戰略性新興產業的發展需求。

papers.title: RF Magnetron Sputtered Tungsten Disulfide Films: Influence of Target Preparation, Deposition Parameters, and Storage Conditions on Thin Film Stoichiometry
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Sputtering of tungsten disulfide (WS 2 ) thin films at room temperature represents a significant challenge in terms of stoichiometry. Often, sulfur is lost during deposition and the resulting thin films contain many defects, due to the high energy impact from the plasma process. The target material is also affected by these phenomena. It has been demonstrated that the storage in ambient atmosphere results in oxidation of the films and the target. This study examines the impact of pre‐sputter time and deposition power on the chemical composition and structure of WS 2 thin films. The target was stored in atmospheric condition and in a dark ambient before mounting into deposition chamber. The impact of light irradiation was examined, with a focus on the chemical and structural modifications of the films. EDS was utilized to analyze the chemical compositions of target and films, while AFM, SEM, TEM and XRD were employed to examine the microstructure of the films depending on the deposition conditions. The thin films have a WS x O y composition with varying S‐ and O‐content. For low sputter power an increasing tendency for crystalline behavior at the surface along with a higher S‐content was observed, while films deposited at 80 W remain X‐ray amorphous.

papers.title: Praseodymium Doping Effect on Indium Tin Zinc Oxide Target Densification Process for High‐Performance TFTs
papers.venue: Journal of the American Ceramic Society
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Indium‐tin‐zinc oxide (ITZO) is widely used in optoelectronic thin film transistors (TFTs) due to its excellent electrical properties and optical transparency. As the basic material for thin films, the preparation of high‐quality ITZO targets to realize the optimal performance of TFT is a challenge. In this study, high‐performance indium tin zinc oxide targets with different praseodymium (Pr) doping contents (PrITZO) with the densities of the produced targets exceed 99.0%, average grain sizes controlled within 2.3 µm, and resistivities lower than 6 mΩ·cm were prepared under two‐step sintering conditions for application in TFTs. The effects of Pr doping on the density, phase composition, grain size, and resistivity during the target densification process were further explored, and the relevant properties were verified by sputtering thin films used as the channel layer of TFT devices. The results showed that the sputtered films and TFT devices based on the target with a Pr doping of 2 wt% (ITZO‐2%Pr) exhibited excellent overall performance: the average roughness ( R a) of the film was 1.18 nm, the average transmittance ( T ) in the visible region reached 90.48%, and the TFT mobility ( µ FE ) was 22.42 cm 2 /Vs. This study not only developed a mechanism of Pr doping on the microstructure and performance of ITZO targets, but also provided an important theoretical basis and experimental support for the preparation of high‐quality Pr‐doped indium‐zinc oxide (PrITZO) targets and the application in high‐performance TFT devices.

papers.title: From Copper Nanoparticles to Alumina Encapsulated Porous Layers With Enhanced Mechanical Stability
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Nanoparticle‐based structures are of significance for emerging technologies from antimicrobial coatings to catalysts. Sputtering based fabrication routes are particularly promising whenever high purity and monodisperse particles are required. This work establishes quantitative synthesis‐structure relations for Cu‐nanoparticles (diameter < 10 nm), synthesized through magnetron sputtering inert gas condensation and high‐power impulse hollow cathode sputtering. The two deposition methods are compared in terms of nanoparticle deposition rate, morphology and size distribution. While magnetron sputtering inert gas condensation with quadrupole mass spectrometry offers excellent control of the size distribution of single‐crystal particles, high‐power impulse hollow cathode sputtering enables deposition of polycrystalline nanoparticles at higher deposition rates with more efficient target utilization. Consequently, porous, randomly assembled nanoparticle‐based films of up to 1.5 µm thickness have been fabricated. Stabilization of these structures via atomic layer deposition (ALD‐Al 2 O 3 , thickness up to 20 nm) is demonstrated through electron microscopy and nanoscratching, linking nanoscale structure to macroscale mechanical performance. While ALD encapsulation at 120°C does not change the Cu microstructure, the scratch resistance of the films improves with increasing encapsulation layer thickness. These findings provide a direct pathway from fundamental surface engineering to thick and robust functional nanoparticle‐based films for future bio‐medical and energy applications.

papers.title: Supplementary information for Facile fabrication of highly conductive and dense indium tin oxide targets by cold sintering assisted process
papers.abstract: Supplementary information for Yu, T., Bao, X., Sun, B., Zhou, Z., & Zhang, H. (2025). Facile fabrication of highly conductive and dense indium tin oxide targets by cold sintering assisted process. Materials Today Communications, 114458Article abstractIndium tin oxide (ITO) ceramic sputtering targets are widely used to produce electrically conductive transparent thin films for various optoelectronic devices. However, it is challenging to produce high quality targets due to the poor sinterability of ITO powders. Conventional sintering of polycrystalline ITO ceramics is prevalently performed at very high temperatures (1550–1650 °C) for very long time (10 h) in an oxygen atmosphere. Here, we produced ITO targets with high density and low resistivity by cold sintering assisted process at reduced sintering temperature and time. ITO ceramics were first prepared via cold sintering process (CSP) at 250 °C for 1 h. As-CSPed samples consisted of nanocrystalline grains and amorphous phase. Subsequently, post-annealing was conducted in air at 1400 °C for 4 h to facilitate both crystallisation of the amorphous phase and densification. For comparison, ITO ceramics were also produced by conventional sintering at the identical condition (1400 °C for 4 h). The samples produced by cold sintering assisted process exhibited much higher density of 98.6 % and lower resistivity of 3.63 × 10−4 Ω·cm than the corresponding values (63.4 % and 2.10 × 10−3 Ω·cm) from conventionally sintered samples. These optimal properties attained from this work are comparable to the best reported values for bulk ITO ceramics so far. More importantly, such a high performance is achieved by a cost-effective processing route without atmospheric control and sintering aids. Thus, our results demonstrate the potential of alternative densification strategy for facile fabrication of high-quality ITO targets.© the authors

(2025). 以冷燒結輔助製程簡易製備高導電性與高緻密度氧化銦錫靶材。Materials Today Communications, 114458 之補充資料。文章摘要:氧化銦錫(ITO)陶瓷濺鍍靶材廣泛用於製作各類光電元件所需的導電透明薄膜。然而,由於 ITO 粉末燒結性不佳,要製作高品質靶材相當困難。多晶 ITO 陶瓷的傳統燒結普遍需在氧氣氣氛中以極高溫度(1550–1650 °C)進行極長時間(10 h)。本研究以冷燒結輔助製程,在較低的燒結溫度與較短時間下製備出高緻密度、低電阻率的 ITO 靶材。首先以冷燒結製程(CSP)於 250 °C 下處理 1 h 製備 ITO 陶瓷。CSP 後的樣品由奈米晶粒與非晶相組成。隨後於空氣中以 1400 °C 進行 4 h 後退火,以同時促進非晶相結晶與緻密化。作為比較,亦以相同條件(1400 °C、4 h)傳統燒結製備 ITO 陶瓷。冷燒結輔助製程所製樣品展現 98.6 % 的高密度與 3.63 × 10−4 Ω·cm 的低電阻率,遠優於傳統燒結樣品的對應值(63.4 % 與 2.10 × 10−3 Ω·cm)。本研究所得之最佳性質可與迄今報導之塊材 ITO 陶瓷最佳值相媲美。更重要的是,此高性能係透過無需氣氛控制與燒結助劑、具成本效益的製程路線達成。因此,本研究結果證明此替代緻密化策略在簡易製備高品質 ITO 靶材上的潛力。© the authors

papers.title: PHOTORESISTIC EFFECT IN PB1–ₓCDₓS FILMS PRODUCED BY VACUUM DEPOSITION
papers.venue: Bulletin of the South Ural State University series Mathematics Mechanics Physics
papers.abstract: This paper aims to obtain thin photoresistive films of lead sulfide doped with cadmium using magnetron sputtering and electron beam evaporation in a vacuum. It describes the methods of solid phase synthesis of lead-cadmium sulfide solid solutions of the required composition and sintering of a ceramic target for DC magnetron sputtering. The composition of the resulting targets corresponds to a homogeneous solid solution based on galena. Pb0,96Cd0,04S films were deposited by spluttering a ceramic target with magnetron DC spraying onto sitall and silicon substrates. The phase composition of the deposited films corresponds to that of the sputtered target and the resulting films exhibit a photoresistive effect. The authors determined the dark-light resistance ratio and time constants of the obtained photoresistive films. Pb0,96Cd0,04S films on silicon substrates exhibit higher sensitivity compared to those deposited on sitall. Pb0,88Cd0,12S and CDs were deposited by electron beam evaporation from a graphite crucible. Pb0,88Cd0,12S films deposited using the electron beam method showed no photoresistive effect. The best dark-light resistance ratio and a time constant of 25 microseconds were demonstrated by Pb0,96Cd0,04S films on a silicon substrate.

papers.title_zh: 真空沉積製備之 Pb1–ₓCdₓS 薄膜的光阻效應
papers.abstract_zh: 本文旨在以真空中的磁控濺鍍與電子束蒸鍍,製備摻鎘硫化鉛光阻薄膜。文中說明以固相合成法製備所需組成之硫化鉛鎘固溶體,以及燒結用於直流磁控濺鍍之陶瓷靶材的方法。所得靶材組成對應於以方鉛礦為基礎的均勻固溶體。以直流磁控濺鍍陶瓷靶材,將 Pb0,96Cd0,04S 薄膜沉積於微晶玻璃(sitall)與矽基板上。沉積薄膜的相組成與濺鍍靶材一致,且所得薄膜呈現光阻效應。作者測定了所得光阻薄膜的暗/亮電阻比與時間常數。矽基板上的 Pb0,96Cd0,04S 薄膜較沉積於微晶玻璃者具有更高靈敏度。Pb0,88Cd0,12S 與 CdS 則以石墨坩堝進行電子束蒸鍍沉積。以電子束法沉積的 Pb0,88Cd0,12S 薄膜未呈現光阻效應。矽基板上的 Pb0,96Cd0,04S 薄膜展現最佳的暗/亮電阻比及 25 微秒的時間常數。

papers.title: Effect of multidirectional rolling on texture evolution and sputtering film deposition in Ti targets
papers.abstract: High-purity Titanium (Ti) sputtering targets are essential for the fabrication of advanced Ti-based thin films with excellent electrical conductivity, adhesion and diffusion barrier properties, and the important role of Ti films as functional layers in integrated circuits makes Ti targets indispensable sputtering materials in advanced manufacturing. The grain size and {0001} basal texture of Ti targets are crucial factors determining sputtering performance and film quality. In this study, high-purity Ti ingots (99.9994 wt.%) were processed via multi-directional rolling at 0°, 45° and 90° combined with annealing. The sample rolled at 45° achieved the finest grains with an average grain size of 15.77 μm, which is much lower than the 30 μm standard for commercial titanium targets. And the rolling strategy effectively regulated the {0001} basal texture, with the <0001>//ND fraction decreasing from 42.7% (unidirectional rolling) to 16.7% (90° cross-rolling). In addition, This work revealed the correlation between target grain size and the {0001} texture evolution and deposited film properties. Notably, the 45° rolled annealed target delivered the highest film deposition rate of 22.02 nm/min, exceeding the deposition rate of 17.70 nm/min of the unidirectionally rolled target. The findings provide valuable guidance for the preparation and performance optimization of high-purity Ti sputtering targets.

papers.title_zh: 多向軋延對 Ti 靶材織構演變與濺鍍薄膜沉積之影響
papers.abstract_zh: 高純度鈦(Ti)濺鍍靶材對於製作具優異導電性、附著性與擴散阻障特性的先進 Ti 系薄膜至關重要,而 Ti 薄膜作為積體電路功能層的重要角色,使 Ti 靶材成為先進製造中不可或缺的濺鍍材料。Ti 靶材的晶粒尺寸與 {0001} 基面織構是決定濺鍍性能與薄膜品質的關鍵因素。本研究將高純度 Ti 鑄錠(99.9994 wt.%)以 0°、45° 及 90° 多向軋延並搭配退火進行加工。45° 軋延樣品獲得最細晶粒,平均晶粒尺寸為 15.77 μm,遠低於商用鈦靶材 30 μm 的標準。且軋延策略有效調控 {0001} 基面織構,<0001>//ND 比例由 42.7%(單向軋延)降至 16.7%(90° 交叉軋延)。此外,本研究揭示了靶材晶粒尺寸與 {0001} 織構演變及沉積薄膜性質之間的關聯。值得注意的是,45° 軋延退火靶材的薄膜沉積速率最高,達 22.02 nm/min,超過單向軋延靶材的 17.70 nm/min。研究結果為高純度 Ti 濺鍍靶材的製備與性能最佳化提供了寶貴指引。

papers.title: Durability Enhancement of Aluminum Sputtering Targets via Anodized Surface Treatment
papers.abstract: Rotary aluminum sputtering targets require durable inner surfaces to withstand long-term exposure to flowing coolant, which can induce corrosion, wear, and thermal degradation. In this study, the effect of inner-surface treatment on the durability of cylindrical aluminum sputtering targets was systematically investigated by comparing untreated aluminum, chromium-plated aluminum, and anodized aluminum surfaces with different oxide thicknesses. Chromium plating increased surface hardness and improved wear resistance compared to untreated aluminum; however, interfacial delamination and a noticeable reduction in thermal conductivity were observed. Anodized aluminum surfaces exhibited enhanced corrosion resistance without forming discrete interfacial layers, while the Anodized Al–Thin condition showed a marked increase in surface hardness. While excessively thick anodic oxide layers showed brittle wear behavior, the Anodized Al–Thin condition provided stable friction behavior, low wear volume, and minimal thermal penalty. Thin film deposition experiments confirmed that inner-surface anodizing does not adversely affect aluminum film thickness or electrical resistivity after annealing. These results suggest that anodized aluminum with a controlled oxide thickness offers a promising inner-surface protection strategy for rotary sputtering targets, providing improved corrosion and wear resistance without compromising thermal management or thin film performance.
papers.summary: 比較旋轉鋁靶內壁未處理、鍍鉻與不同厚度陽極氧化處理。薄陽極氧化層兼具耐蝕、耐磨與低熱損失,且不影響鋁膜厚度與電阻率;鍍鉻則有脫層與導熱下降問題。
papers.title_zh: 以陽極氧化表面處理提升鋁濺鍍靶材耐久性
papers.abstract_zh: 旋轉式鋁濺鍍靶材需具備耐久的內表面,以承受長期暴露於流動冷卻液所引起的腐蝕、磨耗與熱劣化。本研究系統性探討內表面處理對圓柱形鋁濺鍍靶材耐久性的影響,比較未處理鋁、鍍鉻鋁及不同氧化層厚度之陽極氧化鋁表面。與未處理鋁相比,鍍鉻可提高表面硬度並改善耐磨性;然而觀察到界面剝離及熱傳導率明顯下降。陽極氧化鋁表面在未形成獨立界面層的情況下展現更佳的耐蝕性,而 Anodized Al–Thin 條件則表面硬度顯著提升。過厚的陽極氧化層呈現脆性磨耗行為,而 Anodized Al–Thin 條件則提供穩定的摩擦行為、低磨耗體積及極小的熱性能損失。薄膜沉積實驗證實,內表面陽極氧化處理不會對退火後的鋁薄膜厚度或電阻率造成不良影響。這些結果顯示,具受控氧化層厚度的陽極氧化鋁是旋轉式濺鍍靶材極具潛力的內表面保護策略,可在不影響熱管理或薄膜性能的前提下提升耐蝕性與耐磨性。

papers.title: Microstructure, Texture, and Mechanical Properties of 6N Ultra-High-Purity Copper Processed by Cryorolling for Advanced Sputtering Targets
papers.abstract: The performance of ultra-high-purity copper sputtering targets is critical for nanoscale integrated circuit fabrication, yet challenges such as dynamic recovery and recrystallization hinder grain refinement and texture control. In the present work, cryogenic deformation was introduced to address these issues. Through electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and mechanical testing, the microstructure, texture, and mechanical properties of 6N ultra-high-purity copper processed by room-temperature rolling (RTR) and cryorolling (CR) were comparatively investigated. Results reveal that RTR deformation is dominated by slip mechanisms; the RTR sample with 90% reduction exhibits obvious dynamic recrystallization (DRX) and forms a bimodal structure dominated by Copper ({112}⟨111⟩) and S ({123}⟨634⟩) textures. In contrast, CR suppresses thermal activation processes, enabling deformation mechanisms suggestive of twinning activity, leading to ultrafine fibrous structures, while shifting texture components toward Brass ({110}⟨112⟩) and S. Compared to RTR-processed samples, CR-processed samples possess superior mechanical performance. The CR sample with 90% reduction exhibits: a microhardness of 164.60 HV, a yield strength of 385.61 MPa, and a tensile strength of 648.02 MPa, which are, respectively, 33.2%, 91.7%, and 84.6% higher than those of RTR counterparts. Williamson–Hall analysis confirms that the CR sample with 90% reduction achieves finer substructure sizes (~133 nm) and higher stored energy (~22 J·mol−1) by suppressing dynamic recovery, providing a robust driving force for subsequent annealing. This work demonstrates that cryorolling optimizes microstructure and texture through twin-dislocation synergy, providing a fundamental basis for the development of advanced sputtering targets.

papers.title_zh: 應用於先進濺鍍靶材之深冷軋延 6N 超高純度銅的微結構、織構與機械性質
papers.abstract_zh: 超高純度銅濺鍍靶材的性能對奈米級積體電路製造至關重要,然而動態回復與再結晶等問題阻礙了晶粒細化與織構控制。本研究導入深冷變形以解決這些問題。透過電子背向散射繞射(EBSD)、X 光繞射(XRD)與機械測試,比較研究室溫軋延(RTR)與深冷軋延(CR)加工之 6N 超高純度銅的微結構、織構與機械性質。結果顯示,RTR 變形以滑移機制為主;90% 軋縮率的 RTR 樣品呈現明顯的動態再結晶(DRX),並形成以 Copper({112}⟨111⟩)與 S({123}⟨634⟩)織構為主的雙峰結構。相對地,CR 抑制熱活化過程,使變形機制顯示出雙晶活動跡象,形成超細纖維狀結構,同時使織構成分轉向 Brass({110}⟨112⟩)與 S。與 RTR 樣品相比,CR 樣品具有更優異的機械性能。90% 軋縮率的 CR 樣品展現 164.60 HV 的微硬度、385.61 MPa 的降伏強度及 648.02 MPa 的抗拉強度,分別較 RTR 對照樣品高出 33.2%、91.7% 及 84.6%。Williamson–Hall 分析證實,90% 軋縮率的 CR 樣品藉由抑制動態回復,獲得更細的次結構尺寸(~133 nm)與更高的儲存能(~22 J·mol−1),為後續退火提供強大的驅動力。本研究證明深冷軋延可透過雙晶-差排協同作用最佳化微結構與織構,為先進濺鍍靶材的開發提供基礎依據。

papers.title: Facile fabrication of highly conductive and dense indium tin oxide targets by cold sintering assisted process
papers.abstract: Indium tin oxide (ITO) ceramic sputtering targets are widely used to produce electrically conductive transparent thin films for various optoelectronic devices. However, it is challenging to produce high quality targets due to the poor sinterability of ITO powders. Conventional sintering of polycrystalline ITO ceramics is prevalently performed at very high temperatures (1550–1650 °C) for very long time (10 h) in an oxygen atmosphere. Here, we produced ITO targets with high density and low resistivity by cold sintering assisted process at reduced sintering temperature and time. ITO ceramics were first prepared via cold sintering process (CSP) at 250 °C for 1 h. As-CSPed samples consisted of nanocrystalline grains and amorphous phase. Subsequently, post-annealing was conducted in air at 1400 °C for 4 h to facilitate both crystallisation of the amorphous phase and densification. For comparison, ITO ceramics were also produced by conventional sintering at the identical condition (1400 °C for 4 h). The samples produced by cold sintering assisted process exhibited much higher density of 98.6 % and lower resistivity of 3.63 × 10 −4 Ω·cm than the corresponding values (63.4 % and 2.10 × 10 −3 Ω·cm) from conventionally sintered samples. These optimal properties attained from this work are comparable to the best reported values for bulk ITO ceramics so far. More importantly, such a high performance is achieved by a cost-effective processing route without atmospheric control and sintering aids. Thus, our results demonstrate the potential of alternative densification strategy for facile fabrication of high-quality ITO targets.

papers.title: Gyrokinetic Simulations of a Low Recycling Scrape-off Layer without a Lithium Target
papers.abstract: Low-recycling regimes are appealing because they entail a high edge temperature and low edge density which are good for core confinement. However, due to considerably enhanced heat flux, the exhaust problems become severe. In addition, in the low-recycling regime, the conventional fluid simulations may not capture the physics of the Scrape-Off Layer (SOL) plasma that lies in the long mean free path regime; kinetic calculations become necessary. In this paper, by performing both Kinetic and fluid simulations, we explore the feasibility of a low-recycling regime in the magnetic geometry of the Spherical Tokamak for Energy Production (STEP); kinetic effects come out to be crucial determinants of the SOL dynamics. The simulation results indicate that a high SOL temperature and low SOL density could be achieved even when the divertor target is not made of a low recycling material. This can be done by using a low recycling material as a wall material. This is an important step towards demonstrating the feasibility of a low-recycling scenario. Lithium, a commonly used low recycling material, tends to evaporate at high heat fluxes which counteracts the desired high temperature, low density regime, and materials that can handle high heat fluxes are generally high recycling. Comparisons of gyrokinetic and fluid simulation results indicate that one can take advantage of kinetic effects to address some of the issues associated with a low-recycling SOL. Specifically, kinetic simulations show better confinement of impurities to the divertor region and greater broadening of the heat flux width due to drifts when compared with fluid simulations. Impurity confinement would help prevent core contamination from sputtering, and a broader heat flux width would help reduce the peak heat load at the target in the absence of detachment.

papers.title_zh: 無鋰靶板之低再循環刮削層的迴旋動力學模擬
papers.abstract_zh: 低再循環運轉模式具吸引力,因其伴隨高邊緣溫度與低邊緣密度,有利於核心侷限。然而,由於熱通量大幅提升,排熱問題變得嚴峻。此外,在低再循環模式下,傳統流體模擬可能無法掌握處於長平均自由徑區域的刮削層(SOL)電漿物理,因此必須進行動力學計算。本文同時進行動力學與流體模擬,探討在能源生產球形託卡馬克(STEP)磁場幾何中實現低再循環模式的可行性;結果顯示動力學效應是 SOL 動態的關鍵決定因素。模擬結果指出,即使偏濾器靶板並非由低再循環材料製成,仍可達成高 SOL 溫度與低 SOL 密度,方法是以低再循環材料作為壁面材料。這是證明低再循環情境可行性的重要一步。鋰是常用的低再循環材料,但在高熱通量下易蒸發,反而抵銷所期望的高溫、低密度狀態,而能承受高熱通量的材料通常屬於高再循環材料。迴旋動力學與流體模擬結果的比較顯示,可利用動力學效應解決低再循環 SOL 的部分相關問題。具體而言,相較於流體模擬,動力學模擬顯示雜質更能侷限於偏濾器區域,且漂移造成的熱通量寬度展寬更大。雜質侷限有助於防止濺射造成的核心汙染,而較寬的熱通量寬度則有助於在無脫靶的情況下降低靶板上的峰值熱負載。

papers.title: Sintering and electrical characteristics of In 2 O 3 -based targets doped with multiple components for solar cells
papers.abstract: Abstract To address the escalating demand for high-mobility transparent and conductive oxide (TCO) films in heterojunction solar cells, multiple components doped In 2 O 3 targets were proposed. The In 2 O 3 targets incorporating 1 wt.% CeO 2 , Ta 2 O 5 , and TiO 2 were sintered under different sintering temperatures and times. All the targets show the cubic bixbyite phase of In 2 O 3 . The microstructure illustrates densely packed fine grains and uniform elemental distribution. Notably, increasing the sintering temperature and holding time contributes to effective pore elimination within the targets. A relative density of greater than 99.5% is obtained for the targets sintered at 1500 °C for 4 and 6 h, and the corresponding optimum resistivity decreases from 1.068 × 10 − ³ to 9.73 × 10 −4 Ω·cm. These results provide the experimental basis of fabricating In 2 O 3 -based targets for depositing high mobility TCO films by magnetron sputtering.

papers.title_zh: 太陽能電池用多元摻雜 In 2 O 3 基靶材之燒結與電氣特性
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 為因應異質接面太陽能電池對高遷移率透明導電氧化物(TCO)薄膜日益增加的需求,本研究提出多元摻雜 In 2 O 3 靶材。添加各 1 wt.% CeO 2 、Ta 2 O 5 與 TiO 2 的 In 2 O 3 靶材,在不同燒結溫度與時間下進行燒結。所有靶材均呈現 In 2 O 3 的立方方鐵錳礦相。微結構顯示緻密堆積的細晶粒與均勻的元素分佈。值得注意的是,提高燒結溫度與延長持溫時間有助於有效消除靶材內部孔隙。於 1500 °C 燒結 4 h 與 6 h 的靶材可獲得大於 99.5% 的相對密度,對應的最佳電阻率由 1.068 × 10 − ³ 降至 9.73 × 10 −4 Ω·cm。這些結果為製作以磁控濺鍍沉積高遷移率 TCO 薄膜之 In 2 O 3 基靶材提供了實驗依據。

papers.title: Design and analysis of a scanning magnetron for uniform planar sputtering onto rectangular substrates
papers.venue: Journal of Vacuum Science & Technology B Nanotechnology and Microelectronics Materials Processing Measurement and Phenomena
papers.abstract: This work presents a novel scanning magnetron for physical vapor deposition that uses planar rectangular targets. It adapts the high-utilization principle of rotary targets (>70%) to a rectangular configuration to improve erosion uniformity and utilization. An innovative magnetron design features inner and outer magnetic poles that form linear and semicircular sections, along with a middle magnetic pole positioned in the gap between them. The middle pole has opposite magnetic polarities oriented parallel to the target surface, matching the polarity of the adjacent inner and outer poles. A driving mechanism scans the magnetron reciprocally along two orthogonal axes: one perpendicular and one parallel to the linear axis of the magnetron. The optimal scan distances are defined as L1 ≥ d along the first direction, which is perpendicular to the linear axis of the magnetron and 0.5d ≤ L2 ≤ 2d along the second, where d is the distance between gap centerlines. The magnetron design in combination with dual-direction scanning achieved 50%–55% target utilization, which is a significant improvement over the typical 30%–40% rates previously reported. The gain results from improved erosion uniformity enabled by the new magnetron and scanning method. To improve full-face erosion at the target edges and corners and enhance particle performance, the semicircular section of the magnetron aligns concentrically with the rounded corner of the rectangular target when the magnetron sweeps beyond the target edge to a limit position. This extends erosion to the edges. Full-face erosion improves target utilization.
topics: 濺鍍行為與靶材利用率
papers.summary: 設計雙向掃描磁控管用於矩形平面靶,改善侵蝕均勻性,使靶材利用率由一般的 30–40% 提升至 50–55%。
papers.title_zh: 用於矩形基板均勻平面濺鍍之掃描式磁控管的設計與分析
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究提出一種採用平面矩形靶材的新型物理氣相沉積掃描式磁控管。其將旋轉靶的高利用率原理(>70%)應用於矩形配置,以改善侵蝕均勻性與利用率。此創新磁控管設計具有構成直線段與半圓段的內、外磁極,以及位於兩者間隙中的中間磁極。中間磁極具有與靶材表面平行、方向相反的磁極性,並與相鄰內、外磁極的極性相匹配。驅動機構沿兩個正交軸往復掃描磁控管:一軸垂直、另一軸平行於磁控管的直線軸。最佳掃描距離定義為:沿垂直於磁控管直線軸的第一方向 L1 ≥ d,沿第二方向 0.5d ≤ L2 ≤ 2d,其中 d 為間隙中心線之間的距離。此磁控管設計結合雙向掃描,達成 50%–55% 的靶材利用率,相較先前報導的典型 30%–40% 有顯著提升。此增益源自新型磁控管與掃描方法所帶來的侵蝕均勻性改善。為改善靶材邊緣與角落的全面侵蝕並提升微粒表現,當磁控管掃過靶材邊緣至極限位置時,其半圓段與矩形靶材的圓角呈同心對齊,使侵蝕延伸至邊緣。全面侵蝕可提升靶材利用率。
